english.title: Place item within 3m of security restricted area fence without authority - Liverpool Airport
english.standardoffencewording: On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..) placed a building, vehicle, structure, equipment, container or other item, namely **(..SPECIFY ITEM ETC..), within three metres of a fence forming the boundary of a security restricted area at Liverpool John Lennon Airport without first obtaining the permission of Liverpool Airport Limited
english.legislation: Contrary to byelaws 2(1)(c) and 4(10) of the Liverpool John Lennon Airport Byelaws 2022.
